title: Couple Under Bridge, 1950s Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black-and-white mid-1950s snapshot capturing a stylish couple posing together under a bridge along a riverfront. The man wears a houndstooth sport coat, wide trousers, and dark sunglasses, while the woman is dressed in a tailored skirt suit with cat-eye glasses. In the background, an arched bridge crosses the water under clear daylight.
